name: ai-trio-ensemble
description: AI CLI diagnostics: muse, codex and agy health/version checks in parallel plus a report (for real multi-agent building use `omnicli team`)

steps.name: Muse CLI Skill Audit
steps.description: Muse: Scans and audits enabled agent skills and coding capabilities

steps.name: Codex CLI System Diagnostics
steps.description: Codex: Performs full runtime diagnostics and sandbox verification

steps.name: Antigravity CLI Engine Verification
steps.description: Antigravity: Probes AGY core engine version and runtime bridge

steps.name: Synthesize AI Trio Collaborative Report
steps.description: Synthesizes outputs into AI_TRIO_REPORT.md and ensemble configuration

steps.name: Git Version Control Checkpoint
steps.command: git init && git add AI_TRIO_REPORT.md agent_ensemble_config.json && git commit -m 'feat: AI Trio (muse, codex, agy) collaborative project run'
steps.description: Git: Checkpoints the collaborative work into version control
